taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-06 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.8 | 18.27 | 18.27
2 | 213.6 | 1.05 | 19.32
3 | 1311.8 | 4.54 | 23.86
4 | 278.0 | 3.10 | 26.96
5 | 1124.7 | 1.46 | 28.42
6 | 291.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-06
Curve type: HK
Aquifer depth: 23.86 – 26.96 m
Recommendation: Target drilling at the moderately resistive, confined layer between 23.86 m and 26.96 m (278.0 ohm-m), which is sandwiched between two highly resistive units and likely represents a saturated, confined sand/gravel aquifer; ensure proper casing through the overlying high-resistivity layer (23.86 m) to isolate this zone before screening.
